jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.content: <p>Acme is a fictional analytics company. You join a small team in Amsterdam.</p><h3>What you'll do</h3><ul><li>Build survival models for client trials.</li><li>Present results to clinicians.</li></ul><p><strong>What you bring:</strong></p><ul><li>5+ years of applied statistics.</li><li>R and Python.</li></ul><p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p><ul><li>Experience with Bayesian methods.</li></ul><h3>What we offer</h3><ul><li>32 days of leave.</li><li>Learning budget.</li></ul><p>Application deadline: 14 November 2026.</p>
